content.text: In the midst of a global financial landscape where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy hold sway, many digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines find themselves locked out of conventional payment processing solutions. This is particularly true for those [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-explained-digital-creators-stripe-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]] [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-5|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-honest-side-side-breakdown-2|ebooks]], courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, who are forced to navigate a complex web of platform fees, KYC requirements, and onerous restrictions. As a result, they're left with a stark choice: either build a custom infrastructure from scratch or settle for a suboptimal solution that sacrifices control and profit. The latter option is all too familiar, as Gumroad's 10% commission on every sale serves as a stark reminder of the costs associated with relying on a third-party payment processor. In contrast, NOWPayments' 0.5% fee offers a significantly more favorable alternative, one that adds up to a whopping $921 in retained revenue at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.

The infrastructure solution being presented here is not a workaround or a patch, but a base-layer infrastructure that empowers digital creators to build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stacks. By leveraging the power of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, creators can establish a secure, scalable, and cost-effective payment processing system that is immune to the whims of third-party platforms. This is not just about avoiding fees; it's about reclaiming control over one's digital business and building a foundation for long-term success.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this infrastructure solution lies a harmonious blend of open-source tools and services, each designed to work together in perfect concert. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation, providing a secure and scalable hosting platform for digital products. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script then step in, handling backend logic, order storage, and file delivery with ease. Meanwhile, NOWPayments takes care of automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, converting cryptocurrencies to USD at transaction time. This seamless integration enables creators to deploy their digital commerce stacks in a matter of hours, not weeks or months.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processing solutions are either unavailable or severely restricted. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this solution offers a unique opportunity to break free from the shackles of platform fees and KYC requirements. By empowering creators to build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stacks, we're not just providing a technical solution; we're enabling a new era of digital entrepreneurship and innovation.
Digital creators can reclaim control over their businesses and build a foundation for long-term success by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure solution include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each of these components is carefully selected to provide a seamless and scalable solution that meets the needs of digital creators. By combining these tools in a single, integrated infrastructure stack, creators can enjoy a level of control, flexibility, and cost savings that was previously unimaginable.

Don't worry; this can be achieved in a matter of hours, not days or weeks. Simply follow the provided documentation, and you'll be up and running in no time.
